finger_flip_bullets.mechanics_summary: 100 spirit per bullet, 60 damage, straight-line air bullet at speed 1000 with 1000 range / 2.0 s life / 20.5 radius, fired after a 0.98-delay charge flick (tap spirit-move-1 + hold toward opponent), repeatable in 0.5 s-spaced pairs while held (maxloop 10). Increase Strength (A470) buffs its damage per the manual/guide.
finger_flip_bullets.cornerstone_feed: CornerStone's Toguro inspiration (PR #426 canon: 'Younger Toguro (Yu Yu Hakusho) as a further inspiration (fingernail blast)'). Feed as a new yyh:YYH-A475 entry in the projectile/spirit-move layer of CornerStone's moveset: a flick-fired spirit bullet using the proven parameters above (charge delay 0.98, speed 1000, range 1000, life 2.0, damage 60-class, 100 spirit cost, hold-to-repeat pairs at 0.5 s, maxloop 10). Animation clips are NOT yet available (ANI payload gap) - wire parameters now, attach the decoded A475/A472 animation when the ANI sampler lane lands. Does not replace any existing entry.
